items.name: Envoy
items.explanation: An open source proxy that sits in front of services, forwards their traffic and can end TLS. Slack uses it as the first stop for the websocket connections that clients open.

assumedBy.quote: Envoy is used at Slack as a load-balancing solution for various services and TLS termination.

items.name: Service discovery (Consul)
items.explanation: A catalog where services register where they are, so other services can look them up by name instead of by a fixed address. Consul is the tool Slack names for this.

assumedBy.quote: The diagram below shows how CSs are registered in Consul, our service discovery tool.

items.name: Network load balancer (NLB)
items.explanation: An AWS load balancer that spreads incoming TCP, UDP and TLS connections across a group of targets. Netflix names its connection limits as one reason to hold more connections on each node.

assumedBy.quote: would have to shard Pushy further to get around NLB connection limits
